name: FNCE 3302
title: Investments and Security Analysis
description: A study of the nature of securities, the mechanics and costs of trading, and the way in which the securities markets operate. Risk-return analysis will be applied in making decisions to buy or sell stocks, bonds and options. The semester-long project requires the student to follow and analyze the performance of individual stocks and a portfolio of investments including stocks, bond, options, and futures. Written analysis is required.
requirement_description: FNCE 3101 for Business majors, or MATH 3650 for Math-Actuarial Science-Finance majors; open to junior or higher Business and Math-Actuarial Science-Finance majors. Not open for credit to students who have passed or currently taking FNCE 3303. May not be taken out of sequence after passing FNCE 4308 or 4309.
